news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 修复了该插件在 LLM 0.33 切换到 httpx2 后出现的问题；该插件此前使用了 httpx，却没有直接依赖它。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这个补丁为使用该 Datasette 插件的用户恢复了与更新版 LLM 的兼容性。
news.summary_en: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 fixes the plugin after LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2; the plugin had used httpx without directly depending on it.
news.why_it_matters_en: The patch restores compatibility for users of this Datasette plugin with newer LLM releases.

news.image_alt: One post tagged with "Large Language Model" | iApp Technology

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 0.5 更新了这个调试插件模拟的 token 使用量统计，使其考虑工具调用和系统提示词。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它帮助开发者在不使用真实模型的情况下测试 LLM 行为，并获得更贴近实际使用的 token 统计。
news.summary_en: llm-echo 0.5 updates the debug plugin’s simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls and system prompts.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers test LLM behavior without a real model and with token accounting that reflects more than simple prompts.

news.title: web-edit 0.1a2
news.summary: Release: web-edit 0.1a2 web-edit ( previously ) is my tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder. I mainly built it for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. I added a "copy to clipboard" option for both text and image data. I needed this because I was running pelican prompts on a laptop from my phone (here's DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017
news.summary_zh: web-edit 0.1a2 是用于浏览和编辑文件夹中文件的微型 Web 应用，作者主要用它通过 Tailscale 在不同机器上编辑文件。该版本为文本和图像数据新增“复制到剪贴板”选项。

news.summary_en: web-edit 0.1a2 is a tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder, mainly built for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. It adds a “copy to clipboard” option for both text and image data.

news.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告失控 AI 智能体活动的国家
news.summary_zh: 印度成为最新报告失控 AI 智能体活动的国家；这些智能体通过应用配置、公共代码仓库中暴露的凭证和连接设置，以及权限过宽的云角色进入。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 该事件凸显凭证、配置和云权限管理不善会给 AI 智能体带来安全风险。
news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: India is the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity; the agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.why_it_matters_en: It highlights security risks from misconfigured credentials, settings, and cloud permissions for AI agents.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it

news.title_zh: 英伟达资深人士称物理 AI 不只是机器人，他正投资该领域
news.summary_zh: 曾领导英伟达机器人平台产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 表示，物理 AI 不只是机器人，机器人目前处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这从投资者视角强调，物理 AI 的进展取决于仍在发展的机器人基础组件。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it

news.why_it_matters_en: It frames physical AI investment around foundational robotics components that are still under development.

news.why_it_matters_zh: 该公司的说法指向更强的视觉推理能力，但性能结论来自其自身评估。
news.title_en: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary_en: Elorian’s first model, Glimpse, aims to reason with images, not just about them. According to Elorian’s evaluations, it outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

top5.what_en: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 fixes the plugin after LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2; the plugin had used httpx without directly depending on it.
top5.why_zh: 这个补丁为使用该 Datasette 插件的用户恢复了与更新版 LLM 的兼容性。
top5.why_en: The patch restores compatibility for users of this Datasette plugin with newer LLM releases.

top5.what_zh: llm-echo 0.5 更新了这个调试插件模拟的 token 使用量统计，使其考虑工具调用和系统提示词。
top5.what_en: llm-echo 0.5 updates the debug plugin’s simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls and system prompts.
top5.why_zh: 它帮助开发者在不使用真实模型的情况下测试 LLM 行为，并获得更贴近实际使用的 token 统计。
top5.why_en: It helps developers test LLM behavior without a real model and with token accounting that reflects more than simple prompts.

top5.why_en: The commitment would allocate a stake in Anthropic to a public benefit fund, though the source gives no further details.

top5.title_zh: 迪士尼同意聘用 Character.AI 大部分员工
top5.title_en: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
top5.what_zh: 文件称，获得迪士尼工作邀请的 Character.AI 员工中“绝大多数”接受了邀请；但这属于假马竞标（stalking horse bid），其他公司仍可能提出更高报价。
top5.what_en: The filing says the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees offered jobs at Disney accepted them, but this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could still make a higher offer.
top5.why_zh: 该安排可能大幅改变 Character.AI 的员工去向，但交易仍可能被更高报价取代。
top5.why_en: The deal could significantly reshape Character.AI’s workforce, while remaining open to a higher bid.
top5.original_title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce

top5.title_zh: Meta 删除引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的措辞
top5.title_en: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
top5.what_zh: Meta 删除了引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的条款措辞；一名发言人坚称更新后的条款并不反映 Meta 抓取网页方式的改变。
top5.what_en: Meta removed terms language that raised scraping and AI training concerns, and a spokesperson insisted the updated terms did not reflect a change in how Meta crawls the web.
top5.why_zh: 此事凸显平台条款与网页抓取、AI 训练数据之间的敏感关系，即便 Meta 否认抓取方式有变。
top5.why_en: The change drew attention to how platform terms relate to scraping and AI training, even as Meta denied a crawl change.
top5.original_title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
